checkpoint: Verify participant age meets the inclusion threshold of ≥20 years using the condition nhid_jk.AGE_GROUP > 3.
Verify participants have at least one hypertension diagnosis using ICD code I10 in nhid_gy40_t1.SICK_SYM, nhid_gy20_t1.MAIN_SICK, or nhid_gy20_t1.SUB_SICK.
Verify continuous insurance coverage by confirming nhid_jk.STND_Y is present for every calendar year overlapping the 365-day baseline period preceding the index date.
Verify exclusion of any CCB or DU prescription during the calendar year 2002.
Verify exclusion of any CCB or DU prescription during the 365-day baseline period preceding the index date.
Verify exclusion of patients with a fracture diagnosis during the 365-day baseline period preceding the index date.
Verify index date assignment as the first eligible CCB or DU prescription date occurring between 2003 and 2012.
Verify drug class identification by matching the first four characters of nhid_gy60_t1.GNL_NM_CD to Study drug mapping.gnl_nm_cd_4.
Verify group 1 in the drug mapping table is assigned to calcium channel blockers and group 0 to diuretics.
Verify follow-up initiation is set to the index date for all included participants.
Verify exclusion of participants who receive prescriptions for both CCB and DU classes on the same index date.
Verify outcome definition as the first occurrence of fracture diagnosis codes starting with S02, S07, S12, S22, S23, S42, S52, S62, S72, S82, or S92.
Verify outcome diagnosis codes are extracted from nhid_gy40_t1.SICK_SYM or nhid_gy20_t1.MAIN_SICK/SUB_SICK.
Verify outcome events are restricted to dates occurring on or after the index date.
Verify baseline covariate extraction window is limited to the 365 days preceding the index date.
Verify extraction of demographic variables nhid_jk.SEX and nhid_jk.AGE_GROUP from the demographic table.
Verify extraction of socioeconomic status variable nhid_jk.CTRB_PT_TYPE_CD from the demographic table.
Verify extraction of disability severity variable nhid_jk.DFAB_GRD_CD from the demographic table.
Verify comorbidity extraction uses diagnostic codes matched to Comorbidity mapping.code from the specified diagnosis tables.
Verify concomitant medication extraction uses drug codes matched to Concomitant medication mapping.code from the prescription table.
Verify healthcare utilization metric is calculated as the total claim count in nhid_gy20_t1 for outpatient and inpatient visits within the baseline period.
Verify statistical model is implemented as a Cox proportional hazards regression with left truncation at the index date.
Verify time scale calculation is defined as days from the index date to the event, censoring, or end of data availability.
Verify proportional hazards assumption testing is performed using Schoenfeld residuals.
Verify all baseline confounders are specified as time-invariant covariates in the regression model.
Verify missing data handling uses complete-case analysis based on cohort eligibility criteria.
Verify primary analysis output includes adjusted hazard ratios and 95% confidence intervals for CCB versus DU initiation.
Verify secondary analysis generates Kaplan-Meier survival curves and applies the log-rank test for group comparison.
Verify censoring rule triggers at the date of death recorded in nhid_jk.DTH_YM.
Verify censoring rule triggers at the date of insurance eligibility loss indicated by gaps in nhid_jk.STND_Y.
Verify censoring rule triggers at the end of the available data timeframe.
Verify sensitivity analysis incorporates varying the length of the baseline observation period.
Verify sensitivity analysis excludes incident fracture events occurring within 30 days post-index.
